steps.code:
# Process all files: read content, derive title, create note
sn_token = sn_login['access_token']
for file_path in dir_listing:
    # Read file content
    file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
    content = file_data['content']
    # Derive title: basename without .md, replace underscores with spaces
    basename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    title = basename[:-3] if basename.endswith('.md') else basename
    title = title.replace('_', ' ')
    # Create note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_token)
    print(f"Created note: {title} -> {result}")
